title: Interval
description: A span of time. Integer years in historians' numbering: negative for BCE, no year 0 (enforced by the rules, not here). A bound is either an exact year or a {min, max} range. end: null means ongoing. date and calendar are display-only; only the integer years drive logic.

date.description: The date exactly as the source gives it, ISO-ordered: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM, with a leading minus for BCE.

calendar.description: Calendar of `date`. Defaults by year when absent: Gregorian from 1582, Julian before.
